n24.fv.intro: {n} strategy × parameter combinations replayed on the T008 training period ({a} to {b}). Each one scores stocks by its factor, splits them into 5 groups, and measures returns over {h} trading days. Four rules fixed in advance decide what is eliminated. Results are frozen and will not be rerun.
n24.fv.chart_title: The more it trades, the more costs eat the excess return
n24.fv.chart_aria: Scatter of monthly turnover and annual excess return for {n} combinations
n24.fv.legend: Filled dot = passed the monotonicity test, hollow = did not. Dashed line = rule 2 turnover cap (100% per month). Combinations with zero turnover are not plotted. Click a dot to see its detail card below.
n24.fv.groups_title: Average return of 5 groups ranked by factor score
n24.fv.no_groups: No group data for this combination
n24.fv.no_cost: No cost data for this combination
n24.fv.rule1: Rule 1: after costs, not below the 5th percentile of random stock picks
n24.fv.rule2: Rule 2: monthly turnover ≤ 100% and annual excess after costs > 0
n24.fv.rule3: Rule 3: held long enough (positions on at least half of trading days)
n24.fv.rule4: Rule 4: group returns are monotonic (G1 → G5 rising)
n24.fv.source: Data: {run} (record fingerprint {sha}…), exported by scripts/export_factor_view.py. A good replay does not prove a strategy works; cost rates are placeholder defaults.
